intended_rationale: Communication availability shorter than rescue time.

source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Recognizing the limitations arising from battery life, procedures shall be developed and implemented such that mandatory communication equipment for use in survival craft, including liferafts and rescue boats, are available for operation during the maximum expected time of rescue.

contract.comparisonModel: battery_life_management_procedure_present = true AND procedure_implementation_status = active AND every mandatory survival-craft communication device shall remain available for maximum_expected_rescue_time_days.
contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

proof.meaning: The SELECT compares communication availability with maximumExpectedRescueTime, rejecting availability < rescue duration; the canonical quantities use the common day scale.
proof.query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:communicationDeviceAvailability ?availabilityNode .
                ?availabilityNode qudt:numericValue ?availability .
                $this nltl:maximumExpectedRescueTime ?rescueNode .
                ?rescueNode qudt:numericValue ?rescue .
                FILTER (xsd:decimal(?availability) < xsd:decimal(?rescue))
            }

            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:communicationDeviceAvailability ?availabilityQuantity .
                ?availabilityQuantity qudt:numericValue ?availability .
                ?availabilityQuantity qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DAY> .

                $this nltl:maximumExpectedRescueTime ?rescueQuantity .
                ?rescueQuantity qudt:numericValue ?rescueTime .
                ?rescueQuantity qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DAY> .

                FILTER(?availability < ?rescueTime)
            }
